messages.subject: Changing UI controls properties
parts:
Hello,

I am trying to change the properties of some UI control.

For instance, say I have a selectInput that lets me select different datasets, which are time series over a certain number of days.
I then create a slider that lets me choose a range of days to display:

sliderInput("daysRange", "Range of days", min=1, max=10, value=c(1, 10))

Now, the datasets do not necessarily have 10 days, so I would like to change max when I change the dataframe, so that if I load a 30 days time series the slider will update to have max equal to 30.

How can I do that?

messages.author: f806781d102fe0ab
messages.subject: Re: Changing UI controls properties
parts:
See reactiveUI function as described here: http://rstudio.github.com/shiny/tutorial/#dynamic-ui

You're essentially going to completely replace the slider each time selectInput changes. Let us know if you have trouble figuring it out.
